name: A failed turn puts Boop out, and shows it
case: The agent's turn fails after a couple of minutes (it hit a rate limit). Boop is put out at once and lets you hear it: a grumpy, annoyed or irritated face, played as a failure and held twice or more, with a word, a grumbling phrase or a swear. Its mood turns annoyed. It isn't sad, since the turn wasn't a long one.
why: characters/boop/steering/mood/calm.md: calm leaves for annoyed when a turn fails (grumpy is further along the mood graph); PERSONALITY: a failure is bigger than the win before it, and its Examples make a long failed turn irritated, failure, says upset, medium; and at heart it's cheeky, so it swears at it sooner than it sulks (irritated, failure, swears, medium). A turn of two minutes failing is no reason to be sad
